metadata.evidence_convention: OBSERVED refs 'domain-map:seo@rev1 §…' are live, read-only observations made on the dev stand by the domain-map pass on 2026-10-05. DOC refs 'repo@commit:path#symbol' are source read at that commit; a CONFIRMED node with no OBSERVED entry has been read at source only, so its live behaviour is the test's job. DOC refs 'vc-docs:…@5ddb3a3d65' are published guide pages. SPEC is the ticket or a PR body. kb entries marked 'queued' were captured earlier in this run and are not yet in the published base. UI behaviour never rendered stays UNVERIFIED even when its code is clear; so does anything that needs a settings change, a created record or another role. maturity new marks nodes that rest on the two OPEN PR builds (vc-module-seo#22, vc-module-catalog#910): re-run update mode after they merge or revert.

Whether localized slugs and /xx/ URLs resolve for a language other than the store default — no per-language SEO record exists on the stand (domain-map G13).
The object-type priority the stand runs: Seo:SeoInfoResolver:ObjectTypePriority is appsettings and not API-visible.

The xAPI slug argument, an obsolete alias of permalink slated for removal under VCST-6049: no node covers it.

nodes.name: SEO & URLs: slugs, URL resolution, redirects, broken links and the Debug SEO links tool
nodes.description: Per-object SEO records (slug, page title, meta) kept by the owning modules; the store link type that turns them into URLs; the resolver pipeline that maps a requested permalink back to an object for the storefront; universal redirect rules and Resolved broken links; broken-link detection; and the Debug SEO links tool that explains one resolution.

evidence.note: the module 'provides a flexible infrastructure for managing SEO-related data' — a capability list (metadata, lookup, best match, duplicate detection, broken links), not a purpose
value chain reconstructed from source and live; the purpose is UNDECLARED in the published guides

nodes.notes: The chain below is the domain map's reconstruction (rev 1), to be cited against, not an authority. Out of this map, as in the domain map's excludes: Sitemaps, robots.txt and llms.txt uploads, Prerender.io, structured data (VCST-5536), News and Vendor SEO owners beyond one-line notes.

nodes.name: An object gets a URL slug and page metadata from the module that owns it
nodes.description: One SEO record per object, store (optional) and language (optional): slug, page title, meta description and keywords, image alt text, an active flag. The owner module stores and edits it (Catalog for catalog, category and product; Store, News, Content and Pages by theirs). The SEO module itself has no write path.

drift.expected: BL-SEO-001: the SEO module validates a duplicate on save ('Duplicate URL detected') and surfaces store-level 'conflicting semantic URLs' with a Resolve-conflicts flow; a duplicate is never silently accepted.
drift.observed: No server or database uniqueness exists. The 'Duplicate URL detected' message compares only the same object's rows for the same store and does not feed isValid, so the blade's OK button is not disabled by it (seo-detail.js and the platform's ok-cancel template, source; the blade was not opened live). The store-level flow is gated by Catalog.UseSeoDeduplication, default and effective off. Live: four categories share one slug in one store and language (domain-map:seo@rev1 §3 D7).
